name: io.github.pyunto/tm-mcp
description: Read your Pyunto Time Management schedule and log time from an AI assistant. E2EE project planning.

environmentVariables.name: PYUNTO_TM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key (ptm_...) minted in Settings → Account → API keys

environmentVariables.name: PYUNTO_TM_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Account password; unwraps the private key locally so E2EE project and task names decrypt

environmentVariables.name: PYUNTO_TM_PASSWORD_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file holding the account password, instead of PYUNTO_TM_PASSWORD
